core_obligations: Henkin-style ladder (proof lines 988-1047): fix the formula enumeration, set Delta_0 = Gamma, and at stage n+1 adjoin A_n when consistent, otherwise its negation - the case definition displayed.

Completeness and extension (lines 1049-1063): the union Delta contains Gamma visibly; every formula or its negation enters by construction, so Delta is complete, with the monotonicity of the chain argued in a parenthetical.

Consistency (lines 1064-1090): two halves - (a) if the union were inconsistent a finite witness set would concentrate in some stage Delta_n by monotonicity; (b) each Delta_n is consistent by induction, the successor step consuming the cited either-or consistency fact for the rejected branch.
proof_roadmap: Peel off one decision per formula, keeping consistency by construction.
Union: completeness is local, inconsistency is finitary.
